messages:
Nadia: Heads-up: follow-up on private controlplane pairing. We need a hardened retry flow that27s safe for NAT-heavy customers.
Ben: TL;DR: one-time token + pairing-id seems fine, but behavior on duplicate redeem must be clearly defined.
Carlos: Implementation idea: treat redeem as "create-if-not-exists". If token redeemed twice, return the same pairing-id and cert blob. That makes client retries idempotent.
Tess: How does the client discover if pairing completed asynchronously? We observed timeouts where server had already issued certs but client timed out.
Nadia: Add a verify endpoint: GET /pairings/{pairing-id} -> returns status {pending, ready, failed} and cert metadata when ready. Keep it cheap.
Ben: Security angle: pairing-id must be unforgeable. Use HMAC(token||client_nonce||issued_at) with server secret. Don27t bind to client IP; breaks many NAT cases.
Carlos: Retry dedupe: clients send a Retry-UUID header. Server stores recent Retry-UUIDs per token for a short window (2m) to dedupe duplicate POSTs.
Tess: TTL tradeoffs: token lifespan 45-90s seems reasonable. pairing lookup window for late-checks 5m default, configurable per-tenant up to 24h opt-in.
Nadia: Failure codes: 409 = token already redeemed (but pairing-id returned), 410 = token expired, 404 = verify endpoint not supported on older CPs.
Ben: SDK contract suggestion:
- pairing.start(token, opts) -> returns pairing_id or error
- pairing.verify(pairing_id) -> polls GET /pairings/
- on failure, sdk can set fallback_to_relay flag
- expose retry_id and client_nonce config
Carlos: Ops requirements: metrics (pairing.attempts, pairing.success, pairing.dedupe_hits, pairing.late_completions), and alert when success < 98% for 15m. Add a reconciliation job for pending pairings that retries cert apply.
Tess: Key rotation: sign keys in KMS, rotate weekly with 1h verification grace window. Make rotation automated for Private deployments.
Nadia: Migration plan: start lenient pairing-mode for 48h in staging; enable strict mode via feature flag per-region; communicate SDK changes to customers with a 2-week deprecation window.
Ben: Edge-case: if server accepted the token but failed before writing pairing record, client retry must not create duplicate resources. Use idempotent DB create semantics keyed by token or retry-id.
Carlos: Storage notes: Dynamo-like table with token->pairing mapping and TTL; separate pairing table keyed by pairing-id for status. Fast token lookup needed for dedupe.
Tess: UX for ops: admin API to revoke pairings: POST /admin/tenants/{id}/pairings/revoke with reason. Also allow force-delete of pairing-id.
infra-bot: Staging endpoint for pairings is up: https://staging.internal/_pairings (expiry: 2h)
Nadia: Next steps: I'll write a short RFC with the state machine diagrams, sample SDK calls, and example logs (200 success, 202 pending, 409 redeemed, 410 expired). Aim to post by EOD tomorrow.
Ben: +1. I27ll add a test harness for NAT flaps and retry jitter.
Carlos: I27ll prototype the dedupe table and metrics pipeline.
Tess: I27ll update the runbook for fallback-to-relay behavior.
Nadia: Thanks team.
